verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is an API platform, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. The evidence does not show one: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file and the markdown versions of doc pages are documentation formats, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
